name: cli-session-suite-tool
body: The session suite tool: the opencode tool that opens a background session, defined in `opencode-suite/lib/apg.ts` and served by the new `opencode-suite/tools/apg_session.ts`. It spawns `apg session start` detached and waits until the session socket answers, then returns; the binary keeps `apg session start`'s blocking foreground contract.
